svg.aria-label: A 12-stage roadmap for building a Cloud Center of Excellence: 1 executive sponsorship and objectives, 2 charter and governance model, 3 cross-functional core team, 4 key workstreams and domains, 5 governance frameworks and tools, 6 self-service enablement (landing zone), 7 pilot projects and iteration, 8 communication and collaboration, 9 training and upskilling, 10 metrics and monitoring, 11 scale and evolve, 12 avoid common pitfalls.
